questions.question:
Find the number whose 6 times is 6 less than 60.

A. 6

B. 7

C. 8

D. 9
questions.solution:
Let the number be x

According to the question

⇒ 60 – 6x = 6

⇒ 6x = 60 – 6

⇒ 6x = 54

⇒ x = 54/6

⇒ x = 9

The required number is 9.

questions.question:
The area of a rectangle is 448 sq.m. If the length is more than the breadth by 12%, find the breadth.

A. 14 m

B. 16 m

C. 18 m

D. 20 m
questions.solution:
Let the breadth of the rectangle be x m

Length of the rectangle = x × 112/100 = 1.12x

According to the question

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

⇒ x × 1.12x = 448

⇒ x² = 448/1.12

⇒ x² = 400

⇒ x = √400

⇒ x = 20

The breadth of the rectangle is 20 m.

questions.question: Mirages are formed primarily due to _________of light.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Total Internal Reflection**__,

**__Explanation:__**

 
• The mirage is caused by the **total internal reflection** of light at layers of air of different densities. 
 
• In a desert, the sand is very hot during day time and a result the layer of air in contact with it gets heated up and becomes lighter. The lighter air rises up and the denser air from above comes down.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/617fac791227b2b6687f6db273c983de14b28361b326a7938e20b22d1ea98c77.png] 

 
• As a result, the successive upper layers are denser than those below them. A ray of light coming from a distant object, like the top a tree, gets **refracted **from a **denser to a rarer medium**.
 
• Consequently, the **refracted ray bends away** from the **normal until**, at a particular layer, the light is incident at an **angle greater than the critical angle**. 
 
• At this stage, the incident ray suffers total internal reflection and is reflected upwards. 
 
• When this reflected beam of light enters the eyes of the observer, it appears as if an inverted image of the tree is seen and the sand looks like a pool of water.

So, **Mirage** is an **example of total internal reflection** which occurs due to **atmospheric refraction.**

questions.question:
**Resolution : Determination : : Consensus : ___________.**

A. Difference

B. Unanimity

C. Decide

D. outcome
questions.solution:
The relation is:

Resolution - a firm decision to do or not to do something; the quality of being determined or resolute.

Determination - having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it.

Resolution : Determination → They are synonyms of each other.

Similarly,

Consensus – a general agreement.

A. Difference - a point or way in which people or things are dissimilar.

**B. Unanimity - agreement by all people involved; consensus.**

C. Decide - come or bring to a resolution in the mind as a result of consideration.

D. Outcome - the way a thing turns out; a consequence.

Consensus and Unanimity are synonyms of each other.

Hence, ‘unanimity’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
N invested Rs. 20,000 in a business. Six months later, C joined him with Rs. 10,000. At the end of the year, the profit was Rs. 10,000. What should be the share of N?

A. Rs. 2,000

B. Rs. 4,000

C. Rs. 6,000

D. Rs. 8,000
questions.solution:
Total money at the end of the year invested by N = 12 × 20,000 = 2,40,000

Total money at the end of the year invested by C = 6 × 10,000 = 60,000

Ratio of profit share N to C = 2,40,000 : 60,000 = 4 : 1

Ratio of profit share N to C = 4x : x

⇒ 4x + x = 10,000

⇒ 5x = 10,000

⇒ x = 10,000/5

⇒ x = 2,000

Profit share of N = 4 × 2 = 8

Which pair is not similar to the other three?

A. Bare : Dressed → They are antonyms of each other.

Bare - (of a person or part of the body) not clothed or covered.

Dressed - put on one's clothes.

B. Baffled : Informed → They are antonyms of each other.

Baffled - totally bewilder or perplex.

Informed - having or showing knowledge of a subject or situation.

C. **Counterfeit : Fake → They are synonyms of each other.**

Counterfeit - a fraudulent imitation of something else.

Fake - not genuine; imitation or counterfeit.

D. Degrade : Exalt → They are antonyms of each other.

Degrade – treat or regard (someone) with contempt or disrespect.

Exalt - think or speak very highly of (someone or something).

Hence, ‘Counterfeit : Fake’ is the odd one out.

questions.question:
X does 25% of a work in 20 days. Y joins X and they together finish the remaining work in 15 days. Y alone can do the whole work in _____ days.

A. 30 days

B. 25(1)/(2) days

C. 26(2)/(3) days

D. 26(1)/(3) days
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fb4ac5d897e3e72b1c88b1f8c179b3c4b8710ce1e77434f33b7d53fe9a127c0.png] 

25% of the work, X complete in = 20 days

100% of the work, X complete in = 20/25 × 100 = 80 days

75% of the work, X and Y complete in = 15 days

100% of the work, X and Y complete in = 15/75 × 100 = 20 days

Total work = 80

Efficiency of Y = 4 – 1 = 3

Y alone can complete the whole work in = 80/3 = 26(2)/(3) days

In a farm, there are goats and peacocks. If the number of heads are 60 and the number of feet are 170, then the number of goats = ?

A. 18

B. 20

C. 23

D. 25
questions.solution:
In a farm, there are goats and peacocks.

If the number of heads are 60.

G + P = 60

= > P = 60 - G ---(i)

The number of feet are 170

4G + 2P = 170 ---(ii)

Substituting the value of equation (i) in (ii), we get:

4G + 2(60 – G) = 170

= > 4G + 120 – 2G = 170

= > 2G = 170 – 120

= > 2G = 50

= > G = 25

Hence, the number of goats is 25.

questions.solution:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Total distance = 40 + 30 = 70 km

Time to cover 40 km with the speed of 80 km/hr = 40/80 = 1/2 hr

Time to cover 30 km with the speed of 60 km/hr = 30/60 = 1/2 hr

Total time = 1/2 + 1/2 = 1 hr

Average speed = 70/1 = 70 km/hr

questions.question:
A man starts walking at 6.30 am. and wants to cover a distance of 30 km. His initial speed is 6 kmph and after covering three-fifth distance, he reduces his speed by 2 kmph. At what time will he complete his walk?

A. 11.00 am

B. 12.30 pm

C. 11.30 pm

D. 12.00 pm
questions.solution:
Total distance = 30 km

3/5 of the total distance = 30 × 3/5 = 18 km

Remaining distance = 30 – 18 = 12 km

Time to cover 18 km distance with 6 km/hr = 18/6 = 3 hr

After reducing the speed by 2 km/hr, the New speed = 6 - 2 = 4 km/hr

Time to cover 12 km distance with 4 km/hr = 12/4 = 3 hr

Total time = 3 + 3 = 6 hrs

Required time = 6 : 30 + 6 hr = 12:30 pm

questions.question: Rajaji National Park is in ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rajaji National National Park, most famous for its elephant population.

 
 
• Located at the Himalayan foothills, near Haridwar, Rishikesh and Dehradun, with Ganga and Song rivers, flowing through it, the park is known for its scenic beauty and rich bio-diversity.
 
• A paradise for nature lovers and wildlife enthusiasts, the park is home to elephants, tigers, leopards, deer and ghorals, and a wide variety of birds. In 1983, three sanctuaries in Uttarakhand - Rajaji, Motichur and Chilla - were amalgamated into a large protected area and named Rajaji National Park, in honour of freedom fighter and first governor-general of India Late C Rajagopalachari; popularly known as “Rajaji”.
 
• This area is the north-western limit of Asian elephants. Spread over an area of 820.42 sq km, Rajaji is a magnificent ecosystem nestled in the Shivalik ranges at the start of the vast Indo–Gangetic plains, thus representing vegetation of several distinct zones and forest types.
